atoms.b: Exactly one year after World War One ended, the very first ((++Remembrance_Day Halloween)) was held.

atoms.a: What did King George V ask the British people to do on the first Remembrance Day?

feedback.finish: The King asked the country to hold a two-minute silence at exactly 11am to pay respects to the fallen soldiers.

atoms.b: During the war and afterwards, many soldiers wrote ((++poems nursery_rhymes)) to help them cope with the awful things they had seen.
One of the most famous poems is called In Flanders Fields. It was written in 1915 by ((++John_McCrae Lady_Gaga)), who was a Canadian soldier.

end.text:

between the crosses, row on row.

feedback.end: Flanders fields is a World War One graveyard and memorial site in Belgium.
John McCrae wrote about the poppies that grew on the fields where the soldiers are buried.
The crosses here represent the gravestones for the fallen soldiers, laid out in rows.
